ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the length of line segment AB is 12. Point C is on line segment AB with BC being $\frac{1}{3}$ of AB. Point D is the midpoint of AB. What is the length of CD?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since BC = $\frac{1}{3}$ AB = 4, \\
Since point D is the midpoint of AB, \\
Therefore, BD = 6, \\
Therefore, CD = BD - BC = \boxed{2}.
